Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Under the _____, the President was no longer obligated to gain the Legislative Yuan's approval when declaring martial law as stipulated in Article 39
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: In 1948, the National Assembly ratified the Temporary Provisions against the Communist Rebellion, which superseded the Constitution by granting the President enhanced administrative and executive capabilities. Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: The Temporary Provisions would persist in Taiwan for forty-three years until it was repealed in 1991.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages

Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Nonetheless, the role of the _____ remains constitutionally ambiguous even today
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Additionally, the President and the Vice President could disregard the two-term limit for re-election as described in Article 47. As a result, Chiang Kai-shek served five six-year terms (twenty-seven years) as president before his death in 1975.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages

Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the _____ is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: The Premier may be removed by a vote of no-confidence by a majority of the Legislative Yuan, after which the President may either remove the Premier or dissolve the Legislative Yuan and initiate a new election for legislators. Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the Premier is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the _____ upon the recommendation of the Premier
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Given the semi-presidential mode of constitutional governance, the Premier is the head of government while the President of the Republic is the head of state. Although the Premier is held accountable to the Legislative Yuan—a common feature of parliamentary systems—the presidential expansion of power has altered checks and balances between the branches of government; functionally, the Premier has become subordinate to the President.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: The _____ serves as the primary policy-making body of the executive branch, convening over administrative matters in weekly Cabinet meetings
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: The Executive Yuan Council, called "the cabinet" (內閣; Nèigé), is composed of a Premier, a Vice Premier, a certain number of Ministers and Chairmen of Commissions, and a certain number of Ministers without Portfolio (MWPs). Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the President upon the recommendation of the Premier.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages
Constitution of the Republic of China.subSubject: Constitution of the Republic of China
Constitution of the Republic of China.question: The Cabinet conducts decision-making through a single majority vote, which may be vetoed by the _____
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Under Article 56, these cabinet members are appointed by the President upon the recommendation of the Premier. The Cabinet conducts decision-making through a single majority vote, which may be vetoed by the Premier.

Constitution of the Republic of China.subject: Indian Languages

Constitution of the Republic of China.question: Like parliaments in other countries, the _____ passes legislation, which is later sent to the President for signing
Constitution of the Republic of China.fact: Article 58 authorizes the Cabinet to assess statutory or budgetary bills concerning martial law or amnesty, declaration of war, conclusion of peace or treaties, and other affairs; the Cabinet subsequently submit bills to the Legislative Yuan. Like parliaments in other countries, the Legislative Yuan passes legislation, which is later sent to the President for signing.

Dionysiaca.fact: Ino marries Athamas, but Semele is reserved for Zeus, who is resenting the death of the first Dionysus (Zagreus), whom he had engendered with Persephone. Beginning of the story of Persephone: all the gods of the Olympus are madly in love with her.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 6 – _____, upset by Zeus's attention, goes to Astraeus, god of prophecy, who casts Persephone's horoscope, telling of her imminent rape by Zeus
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 6 – Demeter, upset by Zeus's attention, goes to Astraeus, god of prophecy, who casts Persephone's horoscope, telling of her imminent rape by Zeus. Demeter conceals Persephone in a cave, but Zeus sleeps with her in the form of a snake, and she bears Zagreus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In anger, _____ floods the world, causing havoc to the pastoral deities and the rivers
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 6 – Demeter, upset by Zeus's attention, goes to Astraeus, god of prophecy, who casts Persephone's horoscope, telling of her imminent rape by Zeus. Demeter conceals Persephone in a cave, but Zeus sleeps with her in the form of a snake, and she bears Zagreus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 7 – _____ on earth is miserable
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 7 – Life on earth is miserable. Aion, god of time, begs Zeus to ease mortal life.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Aion, god of time, begs _____ to ease mortal life
Dionysiaca.fact: In anger, Zeus floods the world, causing havoc to the pastoral deities and the rivers. Aion, god of time, begs Zeus to ease mortal life.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Zeus predicts that the birth of _____ will change everything
Dionysiaca.fact: Zeus predicts that the birth of Dionysus will change everything.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Eros makes Zeus fall in love with _____
Dionysiaca.fact: Eros makes Zeus fall in love with Semele. That night Zeus joins Semele in her bed and metamorphoses into different animals during the courtship.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: That night Zeus joins _____ in her bed and metamorphoses into different animals during the courtship
Dionysiaca.fact: Eros makes Zeus fall in love with Semele. That night Zeus joins Semele in her bed and metamorphoses into different animals during the courtship.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The girl wakes up after a horrible nightmare predicting her death, consumed by the thunderbolt, and is told to sacrifice to _____ to avert the omen
Dionysiaca.fact: Aion, god of time, begs Zeus to ease mortal life. Zeus predicts that the birth of Dionysus will change everything.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Spattered by the victim's blood she bathes naked in a river nearby, where _____ spots her beauty and falls madly in love with her
Dionysiaca.fact: Zeus predicts that the birth of Dionysus will change everything. Eros makes Zeus fall in love with Semele.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 8 – _____ becomes pregnant with Dionysus
Dionysiaca.fact: That night Zeus joins Semele in her bed and metamorphoses into different animals during the courtship. Book 8 – Semele becomes pregnant with Dionysus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Envy tells _____ of the deed and she disguises herself as an old woman the young girl trusts and tricks her into asking to see Zeus armed in full power with the lightning
Dionysiaca.fact: Envy tells Hera of the deed and she disguises herself as an old woman the young girl trusts and tricks her into asking to see Zeus armed in full power with the lightning.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: She does and _____ cannot say no to her
Dionysiaca.fact: That night Zeus joins Semele in her bed and metamorphoses into different animals during the courtship. Envy tells Hera of the deed and she disguises herself as an old woman the young girl trusts and tricks her into asking to see Zeus armed in full power with the lightning.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The fires of thunder burn _____ alive and Zeus immortalizes her
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 8 – Semele becomes pregnant with Dionysus. The fires of thunder burn Semele alive and Zeus immortalizes her.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 9 – Zeus rescues _____ from the fire and sews him into his thigh until he is ready to be born
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 9 – Zeus rescues Dionysus from the fire and sews him into his thigh until he is ready to be born. Hermes receives baby Dionysus after birth and carries him to the daughters of Lamos, river nymphs, until Hera drives them mad.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Hermes receives baby _____ after birth and carries him to the daughters of Lamos, river nymphs, until Hera drives them mad
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 9 – Zeus rescues Dionysus from the fire and sews him into his thigh until he is ready to be born. Hermes receives baby Dionysus after birth and carries him to the daughters of Lamos, river nymphs, until Hera drives them mad.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Hera finds out the whereabouts of _____, but Hermes reaches him before she does and transfers him to the care of Rhea
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 9 – Zeus rescues Dionysus from the fire and sews him into his thigh until he is ready to be born. Hermes receives baby Dionysus after birth and carries him to the daughters of Lamos, river nymphs, until Hera drives them mad.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Hermes then gives the boy to Ino and she places him under the care of her attendant _____, who teaches him the rites of the mysteries
Dionysiaca.fact: Hermes then gives the boy to Ino and she places him under the care of her attendant Mystis, who teaches him the rites of the mysteries.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Dionysus grows up in the mountains of _____ where he learns to hunt and to dominate beasts
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus grows up in the mountains of Lydia where he learns to hunt and to dominate beasts.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: His early pursuits make his mother _____ proud
Dionysiaca.fact: His early pursuits make his mother Semele proud.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In the meantime a mad Ino wanders in the hills until _____ takes pity on her and restores her sanity
Dionysiaca.fact: In the meantime a mad Ino wanders in the hills until Apollo takes pity on her and restores her sanity.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Ino's household mourns for her disappearance, while her husband _____ marries Themisto
Dionysiaca.fact: Ino's household mourns for her disappearance, while her husband Athamas marries Themisto. Athamas goes mad too and slaughters his son Learchos.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 10 – _____ goes mad and kills her son
Dionysiaca.fact: Ino's household mourns for her disappearance, while her husband Athamas marries Themisto. Book 10 – Themisto goes mad and kills her son.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Athamas goes mad too and slaughters his son _____
Dionysiaca.fact: Athamas goes mad too and slaughters his son Learchos.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Ino arrives when he is about to kill their son _____ whom she saves by jumping into the sea, becoming divinized
Dionysiaca.fact: Ino arrives when he is about to kill their son Melicertes whom she saves by jumping into the sea, becoming divinized.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Meanwhile, _____ has become a teenager and lives in Lydia with a court of Satyrs
Dionysiaca.fact: Meanwhile, Dionysus has become a teenager and lives in Lydia with a court of Satyrs. Dionysus and Ampelos indulge in a series of sports contests, the god allowing the boy to win.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: He falls in love for the first time with one of them, _____ (Vine)
Dionysiaca.fact: He falls in love for the first time with one of them, Ampelus (Vine). Book 11 – Dionysus organizes a swimming contest and allows Ampelus to win.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Dionysus and _____ indulge in a series of sports contests, the god allowing the boy to win
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus and Ampelos indulge in a series of sports contests, the god allowing the boy to win.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 11 – _____ organizes a swimming contest and allows Ampelus to win
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus and Ampelos indulge in a series of sports contests, the god allowing the boy to win. Book 11 – Dionysus organizes a swimming contest and allows Ampelus to win.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Ampelus is elated by his success and dresses up as a _____ as a form of celebration
Dionysiaca.fact: Ampelus is elated by his success and dresses up as a Bacchante as a form of celebration.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Totaling _____ books and 21,286 lines, it is the longest surviving poem from Greco-Roman antiquity
Dionysiaca.fact: Totaling 48 books and 21,286 lines, it is the longest surviving poem from Greco-Roman antiquity. The suggestion that it is incomplete misses the significance of the birth of Dionysus' one son (Iacchus) in the final book, Book 48, quite apart from the fact that 48 is a key number as the number of books in the Iliad and Odyssey combined.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: A portent tells _____ that Ampelus will die and become a vine
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 11 – Dionysus organizes a swimming contest and allows Ampelus to win. Dionysus warns the boy to stay close to him, just in case a deity is jealous of their happiness and tries to kill him.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Ate (_____) makes Ampelus jealous reminding him that Dionysus and the gods usually give their friends a special present, a special mount, and suggests that he should make a bull his own
Dionysiaca.fact: Ate (Delusion) makes Ampelus jealous reminding him that Dionysus and the gods usually give their friends a special present, a special mount, and suggests that he should make a bull his own.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Deluded, _____ rides a bull and provokes Selene by saying that he is a better bull-rider than her
Dionysiaca.fact: A portent tells Dionysus that Ampelus will die and become a vine. Ate (Delusion) makes Ampelus jealous reminding him that Dionysus and the gods usually give their friends a special present, a special mount, and suggests that he should make a bull his own.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The animal starts kicking and _____ falls on his head on the ground
Dionysiaca.fact: Ate (Delusion) makes Ampelus jealous reminding him that Dionysus and the gods usually give their friends a special present, a special mount, and suggests that he should make a bull his own. Deluded, Ampelus rides a bull and provokes Selene by saying that he is a better bull-rider than her.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: A satyr brings _____ the ill news
Dionysiaca.fact: A satyr brings Dionysus the ill news. Dionysus prepares the body for the funeral and makes a long lament.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Eros tries to console and distract him with the story of _____ and Carpos, two handsome youngsters who were in love with each other
Dionysiaca.fact: Eros tries to console and distract him with the story of Calamos and Carpos, two handsome youngsters who were in love with each other. During a swimming contest Carpos drowns and Calamos, incapable of living without him, commits suicide.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: During a swimming contest _____ drowns and Calamos, incapable of living without him, commits suicide
Dionysiaca.fact: Eros tries to console and distract him with the story of Calamos and Carpos, two handsome youngsters who were in love with each other. During a swimming contest Carpos drowns and Calamos, incapable of living without him, commits suicide.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Calamos becomes the reeds of the river and _____ the fruit of the earth
Dionysiaca.fact: Eros tries to console and distract him with the story of Calamos and Carpos, two handsome youngsters who were in love with each other. During a swimming contest Carpos drowns and Calamos, incapable of living without him, commits suicide.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In the meantime the _____ visit the house of Helios, the Sun
Dionysiaca.fact: In the meantime the Seasons visit the house of Helios, the Sun.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 12 – _____ enquires when the vine will appear on earth and become her personal attribute
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 12 – Autumn enquires when the vine will appear on earth and become her personal attribute.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Description of the tablets of _____, on which all the oracles of the future are engraved
Dionysiaca.fact: Description of the tablets of Phanes, on which all the oracles of the future are engraved.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Prediction of the metamorphosis of _____ into a vine
Dionysiaca.fact: Prediction of the metamorphosis of Ampelus into a vine. In the meantime, Dionysus mourns for Ampelus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In the meantime, _____ mourns for Ampelus
Dionysiaca.fact: In the meantime, Dionysus mourns for Ampelus. Ampelus is transformed into the vine and Dionysus makes wine for the first time, reflecting on how Ampelus has escaped death.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Ampelus is transformed into the vine and _____ makes wine for the first time, reflecting on how Ampelus has escaped death
Dionysiaca.fact: In the meantime, Dionysus mourns for Ampelus. Ampelus is transformed into the vine and Dionysus makes wine for the first time, reflecting on how Ampelus has escaped death.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 13 – Zeus sends Iris to the halls of Rhea, ordering _____ to make a war against the impious Indians if he wants to join the gods on Olympus
Dionysiaca.fact: Ampelus is transformed into the vine and Dionysus makes wine for the first time, reflecting on how Ampelus has escaped death. Dionysus adopts the vine as his personal attribute and claims to be superior to the other gods, because no other plant is so beautiful and provides so much merriment to humankind.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Rhea gathers the troops for _____
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus adopts the vine as his personal attribute and claims to be superior to the other gods, because no other plant is so beautiful and provides so much merriment to humankind. Insertion of a second legend on the origins of the vine: it was growing wild and unknown of until Dionysus saw a snake suckling the juice from the grapes; Dionysus and his satyrs build the first wine press, make wine for the first time and have the first feast of the harvest, completely inebriated.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Catalogue of heroic troops including seven contingents from _____ and seven peripheral contingents
Dionysiaca.fact: Catalogue of heroic troops including seven contingents from Greece and seven peripheral contingents.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 14 – _____ of semi-divine troops, also gathered by Rhea for Dionysus
Dionysiaca.fact: Catalogue of heroic troops including seven contingents from Greece and seven peripheral contingents. Book 14 – Catalogue of semi-divine troops, also gathered by Rhea for Dionysus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Dionysus sets his army in motion until they encounter the first Indian contingent, led by _____
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus sets his army in motion until they encounter the first Indian contingent, led by Astraeis. Hera deludes Astraeis to go to battle against the Bacchic troops.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Hera deludes _____ to go to battle against the Bacchic troops
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus sets his army in motion until they encounter the first Indian contingent, led by Astraeis. Hera deludes Astraeis to go to battle against the Bacchic troops.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Maenads and satyrs massacre the Indian troops until _____ takes pity on them and turns the waters of the neighbouring lake Astacid
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 14 – Catalogue of semi-divine troops, also gathered by Rhea for Dionysus. Dionysus sets his army in motion until they encounter the first Indian contingent, led by Astraeis.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 15 – _____ become drunk, fall asleep and are bound by the Dionysiac troops
Dionysiaca.fact: The Indians try wine for the first time. Book 15 – The Indians become drunk, fall asleep and are bound by the Dionysiac troops.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Story of the virgin nymph _____, who lives near the lake Astacid, enjoys hunting and refuses to behave like a woman
Dionysiaca.fact: Story of the virgin nymph Nicaea, who lives near the lake Astacid, enjoys hunting and refuses to behave like a woman. Nicaea refuses even to listen to him and the boy becomes so desperate that he even asks her to kill him (a frequent line in the speeches of unrequited lovers).

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The shepherd _____ (a personification of the pastoral song) falls in love with her and courts her
Dionysiaca.fact: The shepherd Hymnus (a personification of the pastoral song) falls in love with her and courts her.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 16 – Eros inspires in _____ a mad desire for Nicaea
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 16 – Eros inspires in Dionysus a mad desire for Nicaea. Dionysus woos her and offers her a number of gifts, which she despises.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: After a day hunting, _____ drinks from a river whose waters are turned into wine, following Dionysus' earlier intervention in the first battle against the Indians
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 16 – Eros inspires in Dionysus a mad desire for Nicaea. After a day hunting, Nicaea drinks from a river whose waters are turned into wine, following Dionysus' earlier intervention in the first battle against the Indians.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Inebriated, _____ falls asleep and is raped by the god as a punishment for killing Hymnus
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 16 – Eros inspires in Dionysus a mad desire for Nicaea. After a day hunting, Nicaea drinks from a river whose waters are turned into wine, following Dionysus' earlier intervention in the first battle against the Indians.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: She tries to find her rapist but soon she realises that she is pregnant and gives birth to Telete ('_____')
Dionysiaca.fact: She tries to find her rapist but soon she realises that she is pregnant and gives birth to Telete ('Initiation').

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Dionysus founds the city of _____, as a double commemoration of the namesake nymph and of his first battle against the Indians
Dionysiaca.fact: Inebriated, Nicaea falls asleep and is raped by the god as a punishment for killing Hymnus. Dionysus founds the city of Nicaea, as a double commemoration of the namesake nymph and of his first battle against the Indians.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 17 – _____ travels through the east and is entertained by a shepherd, Brongus, in a country fashion
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus abandons her and when she wakes up she realises that she has been raped. Dionysus founds the city of Nicaea, as a double commemoration of the namesake nymph and of his first battle against the Indians.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In thanks for his hospitality, _____ gives him some wine and teaches him how to grow and harvest the vine
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus founds the city of Nicaea, as a double commemoration of the namesake nymph and of his first battle against the Indians. Book 17 – Dionysus travels through the east and is entertained by a shepherd, Brongus, in a country fashion.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Astraeis informs _____, son-in-law of the Indian king Deriades, of the defeat of the Indian army and the ruse of the waters turned into wine
Dionysiaca.fact: Astraeis informs Orontes, son-in-law of the Indian king Deriades, of the defeat of the Indian army and the ruse of the waters turned into wine. Orontes is furious and harangues his troops not to fear the effeminate Dionysus and his army of women.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Orontes is furious and harangues his troops not to fear the effeminate _____ and his army of women
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 17 – Dionysus travels through the east and is entertained by a shepherd, Brongus, in a country fashion. In thanks for his hospitality, Dionysus gives him some wine and teaches him how to grow and harvest the vine.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The Indians charge in and at first seem to win, but _____ screams like nine thousand men and detains them
Dionysiaca.fact: In thanks for his hospitality, Dionysus gives him some wine and teaches him how to grow and harvest the vine. Orontes is furious and harangues his troops not to fear the effeminate Dionysus and his army of women.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Orontes and _____ engage in single combat: a tap of a vine cluster on Orontes' chest is enough to split his armour
Dionysiaca.fact: Orontes is furious and harangues his troops not to fear the effeminate Dionysus and his army of women. The Indians charge in and at first seem to win, but Dionysus screams like nine thousand men and detains them.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The Bacchic troops massacre the _____
Dionysiaca.fact: The Indians charge in and at first seem to win, but Dionysus screams like nine thousand men and detains them. The Bacchic troops massacre the Indians.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: During his night with them he dreams that the wild king _____ attacks him like a lion attacks a deer
Dionysiaca.fact: During his night with them he dreams that the wild king Lycurgus attacks him like a lion attacks a deer.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The next morning _____ gives Dionysus splendid presents and encourages him to fight
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 18 – Dionysus arrives in Assyria, where the king Staphylus ("Cluster of grapes"), his wife Methe ("Drunkenness) and his son Botrys ("Grapes") entertain him in their marvelous palace in a drunken celebration. The next morning Staphylus gives Dionysus splendid presents and encourages him to fight.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: While Dionysus is busy filling _____ with his vine, Staphylus suddenly dies and his palace is filled with mourning voices
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 18 – Dionysus arrives in Assyria, where the king Staphylus ("Cluster of grapes"), his wife Methe ("Drunkenness) and his son Botrys ("Grapes") entertain him in their marvelous palace in a drunken celebration. While Dionysus is busy filling Assyria with his vine, Staphylus suddenly dies and his palace is filled with mourning voices.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book 19 – _____ consoles Methe and Botrys giving them wine and hosts the funeral games for Staphylus, with contests of singing and pantomime
Dionysiaca.fact: The next morning Staphylus gives Dionysus splendid presents and encourages him to fight. While Dionysus is busy filling Assyria with his vine, Staphylus suddenly dies and his palace is filled with mourning voices.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In a dream, Iris drives _____ to war
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus returns to the palace only to find his friend dead. Book 19 – Dionysus consoles Methe and Botrys giving them wine and hosts the funeral games for Staphylus, with contests of singing and pantomime.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Methe, _____ and their servant Pithos ("Wine-jar") join the Bacchic forces
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 19 – Dionysus consoles Methe and Botrys giving them wine and hosts the funeral games for Staphylus, with contests of singing and pantomime. Methe, Botrys and their servant Pithos ("Wine-jar") join the Bacchic forces.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: They arrive in _____, where king Lycurgus has been stirred to fight by Hera
Dionysiaca.fact: They arrive in Arabia, where king Lycurgus has been stirred to fight by Hera.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: At the same time Hera deludes _____ with a false dream, in which Hermes counsels Dionysus to approach Lycurgus peaceably and without weapons
Dionysiaca.fact: In a dream, Iris drives Dionysus to war. At the same time Hera deludes Dionysus with a false dream, in which Hermes counsels Dionysus to approach Lycurgus peaceably and without weapons.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Lycurgus attacks _____ and the Bacchantes with a massive pole-axe
Dionysiaca.fact: At the same time Hera deludes Dionysus with a false dream, in which Hermes counsels Dionysus to approach Lycurgus peaceably and without weapons. Lycurgus attacks Dionysus and the Bacchantes with a massive pole-axe.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: In his warlike paroxysm _____ even attacks the sea and provokes the gods
Dionysiaca.fact: At the same time Hera deludes Dionysus with a false dream, in which Hermes counsels Dionysus to approach Lycurgus peaceably and without weapons. Lycurgus attacks Dionysus and the Bacchantes with a massive pole-axe.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Dionysus jumps into the sea where he is entertained and consoled by _____
Dionysiaca.fact: Dionysus jumps into the sea where he is entertained and consoled by Nereus.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Book _____ – Lycurgus attacks the Bacchantes a second time, in particular Ambrosia who is metamorphosed into a vine and suffocates Lycurgus with its shoots, while the Bacchantes throng to kill him
Dionysiaca.fact: Book 21 – Lycurgus attacks the Bacchantes a second time, in particular Ambrosia who is metamorphosed into a vine and suffocates Lycurgus with its shoots, while the Bacchantes throng to kill him.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Poseidon causes an earthquake, but _____ saves him temporarily until Zeus punishes him turning him into a blind wanderer
Dionysiaca.fact: Poseidon causes an earthquake, but Hera saves him temporarily until Zeus punishes him turning him into a blind wanderer.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: While Dionysus is entertained in the halls of Nereus, the _____ army is dispirited
Dionysiaca.fact: While Dionysus is entertained in the halls of Nereus, the Bacchic army is dispirited.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: The satyr _____ arrives at the court of the Indian king Deriades and gives him Dionysus' message: he should accept the cult of the vine or face him in battle
Dionysiaca.fact: The satyr Pherespondos arrives at the court of the Indian king Deriades and gives him Dionysus' message: he should accept the cult of the vine or face him in battle.

Dionysiaca.subject: Indian Languages
Dionysiaca.question: Deriades, a son of the river (_____) dismisses Dionysus' offer of peace
Dionysiaca.fact: Deriades, a son of the river (Jhelum River) dismisses Dionysus' offer of peace.
